2/B + 1/40 = 1/30

questions.solution:
For divisibility by (x − 5), remainder must be 0.
Put x = 5:
5³ − 3(5²) + 4(5) − 75
= 125 − 75 + 20 − 75
= −5

To make remainder 0, we must add +5.

questions.questionHtml: Two trains 140 m and 120 m long run in the same direction at 60 km/h and 78 km/h. In how much time will they completely cross each other?
questions.solution:
Same direction → relative speed = 78 − 60 = 18 km/h

Convert to m/s:
18 × 5/18 = 5 m/s

Total distance to cross = 140 + 120 = 260 m

Time = distance ÷ speed
= 260 ÷ 5
= 52 seconds
